which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (dual primary with OS; OS not met at final analysis)
search_notes: LEAP-015. Merck/Eisai release of 24 Jan 2025: PFS (one of the dual primary endpoints) was statistically significant at an interim analysis, OS was not met at the final analysis; no numbers. Recorded as met under the either-endpoint-suffices rule, but the sponsors and the JCO editorial treat the trial as negative. HR columns give PFS in PD-L1 CPS>=1 (JCO epub 31 May 2025, with ASCO 2025); all participants PFS HR 0.78 (0.66-0.92); OS CPS>=1 HR 0.84 (0.71-1.00), one-sided p=0.0244 vs boundary 0.0204. Registry results posted 2025-11-28. Merck and Eisai quarterly documents before Jan 2025 were not checked for an earlier line on the interim PFS result.

No result found by NCT, HX008-III-MM-01 or pucotenlimab plus TACE. Lepu Biopharma 2026 interim results (HKEX, 19 Aug 2026) say the confirmatory phase 3 in first-line stage IV (M1c) melanoma is still being conducted. Registry record never updated since Dec 2022 (not yet recruiting / unknown).

FRUSICA-2. Innovent/Hutchmed joint topline release datelined 18 Mar 2025 (PR Newswire copy on BioSpace; the Hutchmed HKEX voluntary announcement is dated 19 Mar 2025 Hong Kong time, the same day as its FY2024 results): met PFS by BICR, no numbers. HR first public in the Hutchmed announcement of 13 Oct 2025 ahead of the ESMO oral on 17 Oct 2025: stratified HR 0.373, p<0.0001, mPFS 22.2 vs 6.9 mo; no CI in that source or in the trade coverage opened. Registry PCD is month-only (2025-01), taken as the 15th; registry not updated since Jan 2025.

AcceleRET-Lung. Terminated early for commercial reasons (Roche returned pralsetinib rights) but 223 of ~226 were randomised and a final PFS analysis was done. Earliest source found is Roche's lay summary of results on its ForPatients trial page, dated 18 Sep 2025: median time without worsening 1 year 7 months vs 9 months, no HR or p-value. THE DATE IS THE DOCUMENT DATE, NOT A VERIFIED POSTING DATE: a web-archive copy of the trial page from 12 Sep 2025 has no summary and the copy of 14 Dec 2025 has it. First HR and p-value: ClinicalTrials.gov results posted 5 Mar 2026 (HR 0.59, 0.42-0.84, p=0.0027; mPFS 18.7 vs 9.0 mo). Presented as an ASCO 2026 oral on 29 May 2026 (coverage says primary endpoint met). No Roche, Blueprint or Rigel press release with the result was found before ASCO; the EU CTIS record (2023-505035-12-00) was not checked.

No result found for EndoTAG-1 (SB05) CT4005 in triple-negative breast cancer (PubMed, registry, SynCore website). Registry: suspended for 'study design reconsideration', last updated Apr 2023, enrolment still an estimate. SynCore posted a notice on 18 May 2022 that it was voluntarily ending a Taiwan-FDA-approved phase 3 trial for R&D strategy reasons; the notice does not name the trial, so it is not proof that this one ended. If it did, the row would be terminated_no_analysis. No general web search was run for this row (search budget exhausted).

which_endpoint: Hierarchical all-cause mortality + cardiovascular hospitalisations (Finkelstein-Schoenfeld / win ratio)
search_notes: CARES programme (this trial is the Mayo stage IIIa study; the IIIb study is NCT04504825). AstraZeneca release of 16 Jul 2025: anselamimab did not reach statistical significance on the primary endpoint in the overall population across both trials; a prespecified subgroup (later named as kappa light chain) showed benefit; no numbers. The primary endpoint is a win ratio, not a hazard ratio, so the HR cells are blank: pooled win ratio 1.11 (0.83-1.50), p=0.332 in JCO (epub 29 May 2026, with ASCO 2026); this trial alone 1.23 (0.83-1.84), p=0.259 on ClinicalTrials.gov (posted 17 Jun 2026). All-cause mortality HR 0.80 (0.57-1.13) is a component, not the primary.

No result found by NCT, SHR-1316-III-302 or adebrelimab plus chemoradiotherapy in limited-stage SCLC (English and Chinese web search, PubMed); only the safety run-in (ELCC 2024 poster) is public. Hengrui 2026 interim results (HKEX, 19 Aug 2026) still list adebrelimab for first-line limited-stage SCLC as a phase 3 programme, and none of Hengrui's 26 filing-acceptance notices on HKEX from Aug 2025 to 9 Oct 2026 concerns it. Registry record not updated since Feb 2021.

No result found by NCT, GLS-010-31 or zimberelimab vs chemotherapy in relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma (English and Chinese web search, PubMed). Small confirmatory trial (60 planned); registry never updated since Aug 2022 (not yet recruiting / unknown). Sponsor website not reachable.

Primary OS analysis not done. Biostar 2026 interim results (HKEX, 26 Aug 2026, https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0826/2026082602061.pdf): about 300 of 612 enrolled; 'nearly twofold advantage over docetaxel in both ORR and PFS (OS has not been reached in either arm)'; data to be shown at ESMO (23-27 Oct 2026); enrolment suspended because it was too slow, and the study 'will be either restarted or terminated'. So secondary endpoints have been described without numbers, the primary has not, and the trial may end without a primary analysis. Could be argued as unclear. Registry status unknown, last updated Nov 2023.

DESTINY-Breast05. AstraZeneca / Daiichi Sankyo high-level results of 29 Sep 2025: highly statistically significant IDFS improvement vs T-DM1 at a planned interim analysis, OS immature, no numbers. HR at ESMO 2025 Presidential Symposium (LBA1) on 18 Oct 2025; NEJM paper 10 Dec 2025 (PMID 41370739). Interim win with the trial continuing, so met rather than stopped_efficacy. AstraZeneca H1 2025 and Daiichi quarterly documents were not checked for an earlier line, but the data cut-off was 2 Jul 2025.

No result found by NCT, SZPH-2023-001 or YK-029A phase 3 in first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC (web search, PubMed: phase 1 papers only). SHR-1210-III-324. Registry: 'Terminated by Sponsor', 48 enrolled (actual), last update Sep 2025. With 48 patients the phase 3 part cannot have reached its PFS analysis; the trial appears to have stopped during or just after the pharmacokinetic part 1. No publication or Hengrui notice found (PubMed; HKEX filing notices Aug 2025 to Oct 2026). The sponsor gives no reason.

LEONARDA-2 (lerociclib/GB491 plus letrozole, first line). First statement of the result is in Genor's 2023 annual results announcement (HKEX, 27 Mar 2024): 'the efficacy data analysis of phase III clinical trial for the first line advanced breast cancer of Lerociclib (GB491) has reached the primary endpoint'; NDA submitted 28 Feb 2024 and accepted 13 Mar 2024 (that acceptance notice does not state the result); approved May 2025. The announcement names neither the protocol number nor the acronym: matched by drug, line and letrozole design. This is 22 months before the registry's estimated primary completion (record not updated since May 2023, still 'recruiting'). No HR found: no conference abstract or paper located (PubMed empty for LEONARDA-2 and lerociclib letrozole).
